content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to download [product_name], but I was unable to find a working link. Thanks

Yes, a download is available. [product_name].zip (2.1 MB). However, the download is subject to export restrictions. Why must users log in and register to obtain export-restricted software, and what information is required for this process?

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges accessing [product_name], including difficulties finding a valid download link and frustration about the registration and data submission required for export-restricted software. Export restrictions make the process more complicated, resulting in a less user-friendly experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily locate and directly download [product_name] without encountering registration obstacles or unclear data requirements.
